description: Instructions for Form 8824 (2025), Finley: gives a building (FMV $250,000, adjusted basis $175,000, $150,000 mortgage) for Taylor's ($220,000, $80,000 mortgage) and pays $40,000. Line 15 $30,000, 17 $250,000, 18 $175,000, 19 $75,000, 20 $30,000. Qualified improvement property: additional depreciation $35,000; 'Finley enters $30,000 on line 21 as ordinary income, the lesser of the $35,000 of section 1250(a)(1)(A) recapture or the section 1250(d)(4)(A) recapture limit of $30,000 ... $0 on line 22 ... the deferred gain on the exchange, $45,000, on line 24.' Line 25 $175,000: '$131,250 ($165,000/$220,000 × $175,000)' on 25a and '$43,750' on 25b.
